subsystems.name: Display and optics
subsystems.role: create stereoscopic images at high resolution and wide field of view.

subsystems.name: Tracking and sensing
subsystems.role: detect head motion, hands, eyes and the surrounding room.

subsystems.name: Compute and connectivity
subsystems.role: render 3D scenes in real time and connect to other devices.

subsystems.name: Audio
subsystems.role: provide spatial sound and capture voice.

subsystems.name: Chassis and ergonomics
subsystems.role: hold everything comfortably on the head.

buildSteps.title: Design the optical stack
buildSteps.detail: Engineer the distance between display and lens so the image focuses comfortably; pancake optics fold the light path to make the headset thin.

buildSteps.title: Manufacture displays
buildSteps.detail: Micro-OLED panels are fabricated on silicon wafers with organic layers deposited and encapsulated; each panel is tested for defects.

buildSteps.title: Mould the lenses
buildSteps.detail: Pancake lenses are injection-moulded from optical-grade polymer or ground from glass, then coated with anti-reflective layers.

buildSteps.title: Build the sensor array
buildSteps.detail: Cameras are assembled from image sensors, lenses and flex cables; they are calibrated for position and focus.

buildSteps.title: Integrate electronics
buildSteps.detail: The main board with SoC, memory and radios is populated; battery and thermal management are connected.

buildSteps.title: Assemble the headset
buildSteps.detail: Displays, lenses, sensors, board and battery are fitted into the chassis; cables are routed and strain-relieved.

buildSteps.title: Calibrate and test
buildSteps.detail: Each unit undergoes optical alignment, camera calibration, and performance testing for tracking latency and display uniformity.

buildSteps.title: Install and update software
buildSteps.detail: Firmware and runtime are flashed; tracking algorithms and user interface are tuned for the specific hardware.
